comanda e SC-3127 si mailul e cosmin.radu@example.com, multumesc

input.summary: Customer asks where their parcel is, waiting two days. Gave order SC-3127 and email cosmin.radu@example.com. lookup_order returned system unavailable, so the order could not be checked and the customer is not verified yet.
